megan (pm): Heads-up: proposing a capacity-aware staged rollout for Dedicated & Private. Core idea: percent slices + region capacity check + per-tenant fallback mappings. Aim to finalize today.

sam (eng): Sketch: flag = {percent, tenant_allowlist, max_region_load_pct, fallback_variant, kv_flush=false}. Ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Router reads live pool spare capacity.

jorge (sre): Ops limits: refuse increases if pool spare < 30%. Bake windows: 2h/4h/6h. Auto-pause on error-rate >= 3x baseline or p95 latency +40%.

alex (data): I'll build dashboards and a disagreement check (sample 300 responses/tenant). Also recommend continuous 10% shadowing to eval quality.

lily (cs): We'll recruit 3 pilot customers for 5% step and prepare opt-in comms + opt-out flow.

nina (security): Flag writes must be signed (short-lived creds). All changes versioned + audited. Private deploys require explicit approval.

megan (pm): Fallback policy: default -> model-v1 for quality-focused tenants, model-light for cost-conscious. Option to 503+retry only for non-critical slices.

sam (eng): Runbook snippet: 1) auto-hold on alert; 2) flip fallback_variant for impacted slice; 3) if unresolved after 20m -> revert to 0% and page. Will implement e2e tests + staging shadow.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: feature gate deployed to staging at 1815005566 by sam (eng).

megan (pm): Decision: proceed with staged rollout as sketched. Owners: sam (eng), jorge (runbook), alex (telemetry), lily (customer ops), nina (security gate). Action items assigned. Reconvene after staging results. :rocket:
